---
title: "Image viewers"
---


The github project at [https://github.com/neelsmith/imageviewer](https://github.com/neelsmith/imageviewer) hosts apps for light-table and zoomable/pannable display of individual images, implemented in self-contained HTML files that can be run locally or served on the web. Its github pages site hosts an [example installation](https://neelsmith.github.io/imageviewer/catalogs.html).

The apps support cataloging images in simple delimited-text files, and allow users to filter the light-table display by cataloged data, or by date and location data encoded in the images.

Learn more about:

- [browsing local images](./local.qmd)
- [annotating images with a catalog](./cataloging/)
- [canonically citing images](./citable/)
- [sharing images on the web](./servers.qmd)
